subject.title: Feature: fallbackChannel for hook mappings when primary delivery fails

question: Should hook delivery support automatic cross-channel payload failover, and if so what canonical destination shape and retry boundary should it use?
rationale: A bare fallback channel cannot safely represent recipient/account/thread identity, and retrying ambiguous failures can duplicate messages or disclose hook content across trust boundaries.

options.title: Typed ordered destinations
options.body: Add ordered full destination objects and retry only after definitive non-delivery, with dedupe and all-targets-failed reporting.

options.title: Failure alert only
options.body: Keep the generated payload single-destination and use a separate configured destination only to report that primary delivery failed.

options.title: No automatic failover
options.body: Keep channel delivery explicit and require operators or workflows to handle alternate-channel routing themselves.

recommendation.title: Typed ordered destinations
recommendation.body: Add ordered full destination objects and retry only after definitive non-delivery, with dedupe and all-targets-failed reporting.

likelyOwner.reason: This issue already received product-oriented review from steipete, and the choice affects public configuration, delivery semantics, privacy, and operator expectations.
